name: plain-opus-s1-holdout2-r1-answer_cache_eviction_policy-amplifier-plain-a1
final_message:
When you call `cache.make_cache()` with no `policy` argument, it uses `DEFAULT_POLICY`, which is `"lru"` (`cache.py:3`, applied at `cache.py:7-8`). I ran it to check, and it returned `{'policy': 'lru', 'store': {}}`. `main6.py` calls it with no arguments, so it gets the same default.

The other files don't affect this. `decoy_config.py` (`"random"`) and `decoy_policies.py` (`"fifo"`) are never imported by `cache.py`. `.amplifier/settings.local.yaml` contains only an empty bundle setting.

ANSWER: lru
